description: Image selected for 'Uniform Governance Is How Agents Die' was a ship navigational bridge/control room (photo-1641467613990-b74163e280e3). A ship has nothing to do with AI agent governance. The image matched the word 'control room' in the search but not the actual post concept.
correction: For governance/oversight posts, search for imagery matching the conceptual theme: a compass, a clock, timing mechanisms, a traffic signal, an air traffic control tower (exterior/landscape), or a judge's gavel — anything that signals guidance, timing, calibration, or proportionate control. Do not pick 'control room' as a keyword when the post is about governance principles — it returns literal rooms full of equipment, not conceptual governance imagery.
systemic_fix: When the post topic is about governance, oversight, calibration, or proportionate control (not physical systems), search Unsplash using abstract/conceptual keywords: 'compass navigation', 'clock timing', 'scales balance', 'traffic light', 'air traffic control tower landscape'. Avoid equipment-room imagery for abstract governance topics.
